dataset.name: BACASP-S LargeMB
dataset.description: Berth Allocation and Specific Quay Crane Assignment Problem with crane travel and setup times

paper.title: The berth allocation and quay crane assignment problem with crane travel and setup times

fixture.verification: direct raw-URL download matched the file from the pinned git checkout byte-for-byte

upstream_format.vessel_line: length arrival desired_departure position_cost waiting_cost delay_cost desired_position min_cranes max_cranes processing_time_min_cranes ... processing_time_max_cranes
upstream_format.quay_coordinate_convention: one-based; desired_position is in [1, quay_length + 1 - vessel_length]

source_core: processing times indexed by crane count
crane travel speed and setup duration
synthetic_augmentation: fixed non-overlapping berth-slot projection required by PortInstance
neutral draft values required by PortInstance
zero travel/setup on each crane's first use because the fixture has no initial crane positions
yard-block and gate-lane stages absent from BACASP-S
yard and gate service rates and work amounts
adapter_boundary.not_a_source_claim: The augmented event-driven run is not a reproduction of the paper's continuous-quay MILP, published objective values, or optimality gaps. BACASP-S uses time-invariant crane assignments, so the registered reconfiguration-aware greedy policy has no mid-service reconfiguration actions in this adapter.
